highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: Dell patches critical vulnerabilities in container storage modules and Frontline Education breach exposes school district employee data. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Antino Backdoor Uses Outlook and OneDrive for C2 in China-Nexus Espionage Campaign. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
